notes.title: 1.0.2 Release Notes
notes.notes:
v1.0.2
- Leaderboards display the top 100 for all periods (Daily, Weekly, Monthly and All Time)
- Now players can see their position and score on all rank periods, even if they are not in top 100.
- fixed Cloud flickering when playing using Mouse

notes.title: 1.0.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for playing our game! Here is the list of the improvements we did by hearing your feedback:

- Game Over now triggers at the correct time.
- Now players can adjust sound settings from the main menu. 

We have more to come! Thank you!

notes.title: Game Release Delay Due to Steam Promotion
notes.notes:
Due to the big end-of-year promotion on Steam, we received valuable advice from the platform's support team: postpone the release date of our game to avoid possible negative impacts. Therefore, we decided to extend the launch until January 5, 2024. We understand the anxiety about seeing the game live, but this choice was made to ensure that the launch is a success.

We're excited about the prospect and interest the game has generated, with over 1000 wishlists reached tonight. We are very grateful to all our future players for all their support and patience. We are working hard to offer the best experience possible and we are sure it will be worth the wait.

Thank you for your continued support and we can't wait to share this exciting game with you all.

Kind regards FrozenLogic Team
